latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of muapi-photo-pack-generator skill.
- Generates themed photo packs from a single reference image with strict facial identity preservation.
- Uses Identity Lock Prompting to ensure the same person is depicted in all generated images.
- Supports professional, lifestyle, and fantasy categories (e.g. LinkedIn, Tinder, OldMoney, Cyberpunk).
